title: Demons on a Budget: Adaptive Measurement Placement at the Entanglement Phase Transition
abstract: arXiv:2608.19248v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Monitored quantum circuits exhibit a measurement-induced phase transition between volume-law and area-law entanglement as a function of the measurement rate $p$. Prior work places measurements at random locations and treats the rate as the control parameter. We instead fix the measurement budget and vary the placement process, comparing random placement against hand-designed and learned policies in brickwork random Clifford circuits at matched budget. First, placement geometry matters more than placement information. A deterministic contiguous sweep cuts the half-cut entropy by a factor of 3.4 relative to random placement, while equal-coverage unstructured placement and a greedy policy with full state access do far worse. The effect is carried by spatial order alone: measuring the $k$ least recently measured sites gives $4.14 \pm 0.06$ bits with random tie-breaking and $1.29 \pm 0.04$ bits with position-ordered tie-breaking. translated_title: 预算有限下的“恶魔”：纠缠相变中的自适应测量布局
translated_abstract: 监测量子电路在测量率 $p$ 下表现出体积律与面积律纠缠之间的测量诱导相变。先前的工作将测量置于随机位置，并将测量率视为控制参数。我们则固定测量预算，并改变布局过程，在匹配预算的砖墙随机克利福德电路中，比较随机布局与手工设计及学习策略。首先，布局几何比布局信息更重要。相对于随机布局，确定性连续扫描将半割熵降低了3.4倍，而等覆盖非结构化布局和具有完整状态访问的贪婪策略则表现差得多。该效应仅由空间顺序驱动：测量 $k$ 个最近未被测量的位点，在随机打破平局时给出 $4.14 \pm 0.06$ 比特，在位置有序打破平局时给出 $1.29 \pm 0.04$ 比特。其次，这一效应在相变临界点附近最为显著。
tldr: 在固定测量预算下，测量布局的空间顺序（如连续扫描）显著优于随机或信息驱动策略，能大幅降低纠缠熵，尤其在相变临界点效果最强。
en_tdlr: Under a fixed measurement budget, the spatial ordering of measurement placements (e.g., contiguous sweeps) dramatically outperforms random or information-driven strategies in reducing entanglement entropy, with the effect strongest near the phase transition.
